Relief shown pictorially. Pictorial map showing the Mormon, Oregon, Ox Bow, and California trails; routes of the Lewis & Clark, Mallet Brothers and Long expeditions; and historical sites. "This map prepared courtesy of the First National Bank of Omaha, the oldest national bank from Omaha West." Includes text, index to historic sites, inset of "Territory of Nebraska, showing original boundaries as created in 1854" with note, and color illustrations. LC copy has rubber-stamped with number "313-A" in lower left margin. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
